1.title: US rapper BigXthaPlug arrested on drug and gun charges
1.summary: The rapper, who has faced similar charges in the past, had been due to perform at the Country Rising Festival.

2.title: Jeffries and Kushner Meet Privately as Midterm Attacks Fly
2.summary: President Trump’s son-in-law and the man in line to be speaker of a Democratic-led House discussed how Democrats and the administration could work together.

3.title: The Data Center Backlash Bursts Into the Midterms
3.summary: With opposition to the centers mounting, many Democrats and a growing number of Republicans are campaigning against them.

4.title: Dozens of co-ordinated arson attacks hit southern Thailand
4.summary: No group has claimed responsibility for the attacks, which the military said "aimed at creating unrest".

5.title: U.S.-Canada Trade War: What to Know About Tariffs and the Negotiations
5.summary: Canada suspended trade negotiations, triggering President Trump’s 50 percent tariffs on a range of Canadian goods. Mark Carney said he would retaliate “dollar for dollar.”

6.title: What Canadian Goods Will Take Trump’s 50% Tariffs? Some Pretty Strange Items.
6.summary: Buoys, dog muzzles, capes, national flags and “base metal statuettes” from Canada are now more expensive for U.S. shoppers.
